data.title: Milan 3-2 Atalanta (Oct 18, 2026) Game Analysis - ESPN
data.content: # Ruben Amorim still unbeaten in Serie A after Milan win. AC Milan held off a fightback from Atalanta to close out a 3-2 win at San Siro and move up into fourth in Serie A with manager Ruben Amorim remaining unbeaten in his first seven league games. The *Rossoneri*, who had won 4-0 away at RB Salzburg in the Europa League on Thursday night, took the lead through Goncalo Ramos' penalty, with Adrien Rabiot slotting in a second just before the break. Ramos then saw another spot kick saved, but Mario Gila made it 3-0 on the hour, before Atalanta fought back with goals from Gianluca Gaetano and Nikola Krstovic, however, they could not find an equaliser. Atalanta, though, rallied after substitute Gaetano showed neat control in the six-yard box to pull a goal back in the 66th minute and then Krstovic further reduced the deficit after a swift counter attack with nine minutes left, but Ruben Amorim's side dug in to see out the closing stages.
